3) Co-sell entitlements request (we'll coordinate with AWS/GCP partner reps for enablement)

I've attached our marketplace onboarding checklist to make the steps concrete. Can you do a short call next week (Nov 4–5)? Ben and Olga are looped — they'll own the engineering evidence and listing artifacts.

Subject: AWS co-sell enablement details for Acme Health

Hi all — Tom from the AWS partner team here. Thanks for looping me in. A couple of notes from the AWS co-sell side: 

- We'll need Redwood's Partner Central ID and the SKU(s) intended for marketplace listing to start co-sell registration.
- Required artifacts: listing copy, architecture diagram, security evidentiary checklist (SOC2 cert, data residency statement), and a demonstration playbook for field sellers.
- Timeline: once artifacts are submitted we typically see the co-sell registration clear in 7–10 business days, subject to partner scorecard.

Link to our registry for artifact upload: https://partnercentral.aws/registry/ACME-12345

Attaching AWS's short checklist to make this practical. Priya from GCP — can you confirm if GCP has any additional fields (billing SKUs vs Marketplace listing SKUs) Acme should know about?

Regards,
Tom Rivers
Senior Partner Manager, AWS WW Partners

[Attachment: aws-cosell-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
